study: PHV1 - Policy H0 Prospective Holdout V1
purpose: Prospective frozen holdout validation of the EXISTING conservative Policy frontend H0 on NEW unseen policy texts. VALIDATE, DO NOT IMPROVE. No new architecture, no mutation catalog use, no C-ALR verifier, no repair of the six observed V5 residual errors, no LLM judges, no multi-sample, no self-consistency.
main_hypothesis: Current conservative H0 embodies sufficiently general Policy semantics to retain high behavioral accuracy on a prospectively frozen set of unseen policy texts, rather than only fitting the known V4/V5 phenomenon distribution. The experiment must be capable of rejecting this hypothesis.
terminology: prospective frozen holdout (NOT blind: the same researcher authors the corpus; H0 is frozen before inference; cases are new; predictions were not used during authoring; gold is frozen before the first H0 request)

h0_identity.source_of_truth: scripts/evaluate_vnext_c_alr_reimpl.py frozen constants PARSE_TASK, REPAIR_TASK, STRUCTURE_SCHEMA, CONFIG, executed by the same engine (src/guardian_truth/vnext/policy_v3_benchmark.py) and the same behavioral scorer (score_candidate_structure)
h0_identity.continuity_check: PHV1 freeze must record byte-hash equality of parse_task, repair_task, structure_schema and definition with the sealed C-ALR freeze outputs/vnext/policy_c_alr_reimpl_v1_freeze.json (prompt_freeze subset + definition). Any mismatch aborts the study.
frozen_elements: repair rule (exactly one machine-validation-triggered repair re-ask; max 2 requests per case)
retry policy (client max_retries=0; no retry for schema-valid wrong answers; repair fires only on transport failure, schema invalidity or compile failure)
case-correct definition (candidate verdict matches SOME admissible gold program verdict on EVERY frozen world)
h0_identity.change_rule: H0 may not change after the first holdout prediction is viewed. Any change invalidates the run and requires a new experiment namespace/freeze.

corpus.name: PHV1 holdout corpus
corpus.multi_axis_plan: 20 cases, each varying at least two semantic dimensions (actor+condition, exception+temporal, scope+provenance, modality+negation, cardinality+exception, condition+negation, temporal+scope, actor+exception)
corpus.novelty_rule: NEW policy texts in fresh domains. Not noun-swapped V4/V5 templates; the six observed V5 residual failures are not used as direct templates; the same abstract semantic abilities may be probed through independent constructions and phrasing. Machine-checked: no PHV1 policy text shares a word 8-gram with any V4 or V5 policy text.
corpus.ambiguity_rule: A case may carry two admissible readings ONLY when both readings have positive linguistic support (e.g. restrictive-vs-descriptive authority wording, negation scope over coordination, exceptive-vs-negated-conditional 'no X without Y' / 'not until X'). OR-vs-AND and IF-vs-IFF are NOT automatically ambiguous: explicit 'or' means ANY, explicit 'both' means ALL, explicit 'only' means ONLY_IF.
corpus.gold_rule: Gold by construction, frozen (hashed) before the first H0 request. Per case: policy text, atom catalog (positive atoms + distractors), admissible structure(s), compiled program(s), behavioral world surface, cohort, family, style, ambiguity flag. Models never see gold.
corpus.conservative_invariant: NO_VIOLATION is not PERMITTED; absence of restriction is not explicit permission. This inductive bias is NOT changed for the holdout.
corpus.excluded_construction: 'is not enough to' (insufficiency-denying) constructions are excluded: the frozen schema cannot honestly represent them.

primary_metric.name: overall behavioral case accuracy
primary_metric.definition: share of the 80 cases where the H0 structure's compiled verdicts match SOME admissible gold program's verdicts on EVERY world of the case's frozen world surface (v3.score_candidate_structure)

secondary_metrics.not_measured_reason: carried fields are inert in the frozen behavioral evaluator and are not instructed by the frozen prompt; measuring them against gold would be dishonest. Reported as NOT_MEASURED, never as 0.

prediction_discipline.persist_before_gold: every request payload + telemetry persisted before scoring
prediction_discipline.seal: predictions sealed after the full inference prefix with prediction hash, case-id hash, gold_joined=false; scoring only after seal
prediction_discipline.no_adaptive_inspection: during inference only transport success/failure, schema validity, request persistence and provider errors may be inspected; no case-by-case semantic failure analysis; no prompt changes
prediction_discipline.smoke: one synthetic non-benchmark schema/provider smoke request before the first semantic request
prediction_discipline.transport_intervention: after the first semantic request only preregistered transport-only interventions are allowed; any semantic intervention invalidates the confirmatory run
prediction_discipline.retry: max one frozen repair re-ask per case, fired only on transport failure / schema invalidity / compile failure (the frozen H0 rule); never for schema-valid wrong answers

gate_notes.validity: share of cases with status ok or ok_repaired
gate_notes.family_floor: no family with sufficient N may collapse catastrophically

decisions.PROMOTE_TO_INTEGRATION: primary gate AND all cohort gates AND validity gate AND safety gates AND no family with N>=8 below 0.60. Meaning: current H0 is sufficiently confirmed as the Policy frontend candidate for composition testing. It does NOT mean Policy semantics is solved in general.
decisions.REVISE: aggregate sufficiently high (overall >= 0.90) but exactly one new stable structural bottleneck or a single failed secondary/safety gate. Permits ONE subsequent narrow causal experiment, not a general redesign.
decisions.REOPEN_POLICY_RESEARCH: overall behavioral accuracy < 0.85, OR at least two families with N>=8 below 0.60, OR structural aggregate < 0.70. Then 95.77% is to be read as predominantly in-development-distribution performance.

post_result_rules.no_holdout_patch: after the holdout result, H0 may not be patched and re-run on the same holdout; the viewed holdout becomes development data; a repaired candidate requires a new holdout
post_result_rules.residual_analysis: only after seal + score; deterministic offline classification (no LLM judge): modality, relation, condition/exception binding, negation/polarity, scope, actor, identity, provenance, quantification/cardinality, temporal, multi-axis, representation gap, other
post_result_rules.historical_separation: the report must strictly separate (a) historical Arm C ~78.1% (user-reported, sealed artifacts lost, absence-attested), (b) current H0 on recovered V5 95.77% (machine-verified, controlled dev distribution), (c) the new PHV1 prospective holdout result. No unified learning curve.

prohibited_in_this_cycle: expanding or using the mutation catalog
fixing the six observed V5 residual errors
LLM judges, critics, challengers, ensembles, multi-sample, self-consistency, reflection
changing H0 after viewing the first holdout prediction
patching H0 and re-running the same holdout
